page.title: Solutions for legal decisions that need structure.
page.description: The Astra Legal menu is organized by real use cases: business entry, authority defense, intellectual property, labor claims, government consulting, and asset protection.

services.title: Soft landing for Chinese companies
services.description: Legal guidance for entering, operating, and coordinating with Mexican authorities with less friction.

services.title: Asset protection, marriage, and divorce
services.description: Strategy to protect assets, organize obligations, and reduce uncertainty in complex family decisions.

services.title: Real estate tax recovery
services.description: Review of payments, contributions, and authority acts to recover amounts when a legal basis exists.

services.title: Tax, administrative, and amparo defense
services.description: Defense against authority acts with analysis of deadlines, evidence, remedies, and amparo when applicable.

services.title: Trademark registration
services.description: Search, filing, and follow-up for trademarks that protect commercial identity in Mexico.

services.title: Patent registration
services.description: Legal structure to protect inventions, organize technical documentation, and prepare authority filings.

services.title: Government fine defense and recovery
services.description: Analysis and defense against fines, sanctions, and improper charges issued by authorities.

services.title: Wrongful dismissal and labor claims
services.description: Guidance to assess labor rights, evidence, and claim path when wrongful dismissal may exist.

services.title: Legal consulting for governments
services.description: Legal support for public projects, procedures, procurement, and institutional risk prevention.
